lines.trans: Why do you get in this elevator?
We must talk about our work.
The atmosphere is already very clear.
You hate me since my arrival.
You stole our best clients!
That is the game of our profession.
Press the button to go down.
Wait, the elevator stops by itself!
No, we are completely blocked!
Do not panic, it is nothing.
I am extremely claustrophobic!
Breathe calmly, they will help us.
I send an emergency text to Andrea.
We are going to spend time together!

words.gram: imperative, 2nd plural with direct object pronoun

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.trans: Do not press on the brake.

examples.text: Préviens-moi dès leur arrivée en bas.
examples.trans: Notify me as soon as their arrival downstairs happens.

examples.text: Il arrête de travailler à six heures.

meanings.note: prendre l'ascenseur = to take the elevator

examples.text: Les portes de l'ascenseur se ferment.

examples.trans: The elevator is out of order.
The atmosphere is already very clear.

examples.text: Il y a une bonne atmosphère dans l'équipe.
examples.trans: There is a good atmosphere in the team.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are
to trap, to block, to jam

examples.text: La pompe a bloqué mon maillot.

examples.trans: And I turn on the switch.

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Il se sent claustrophobe dans les petits espaces.
examples.trans: He feels claustrophobic in small spaces.

examples.text: Cécile est une cliente de l'agence.
examples.trans: Cécile is a client of the agency.

meanings.note: dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.
Je suis seule depuis trois mois.
examples.trans: I've been on my own for three months.

meanings.en: for (a length of time, still going on)
meanings.note: with the present: je suis là depuis trois mois

examples.text: J'essaierai de descendre un week-end bientôt.
examples.trans: I'll try to come down for a weekend soon.

descendre.gloss: to go down, to travel down

meanings.en: to go down, to come down (stairs, or out of a vehicle)
to travel south / down from Paris for a visit

examples.trans: I have to see the play.

examples.text: Elle avait déjà pris sa décision.
examples.trans: She had already made her decision.

meanings.note: tu es déjà venu? = have you been here before?

meanings.en: as a noun: the whole, a set

examples.trans: I love your acting on stage.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille

meanings.en: to go up, to get on

meanings.note: monter à cheval; often just monter

examples.trans: What do you do for a living?

meanings.note: ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
tag at the end of a question

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

meanings.note: in a sentence with ne: je ne sais rien
before the noun: le seul agent

examples.text: Si Kadropov sort avec une belle femme comme toi, il le dit à tout le monde!
examples.trans: If Kadropov goes out with a beautiful woman like you, he tells everyone!

meanings.note: passé composé with 'être': elle est sortie

meanings.en: sortir avec quelqu'un = to go out with someone, to date

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

meanings.note: sur la table, sur la route
tout le temps = all the time

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
c'est une urgence = it's an emergency
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
